# Registration, contacts and volunteer onboarding

<!-- codeforge:local-only:start -->

Section 4 · Functional specifications

Parent page: [Functional specifications](section-4.md)

<!-- codeforge:local-only:end -->

<!-- codeforge:body:start (testo scrivibile: e' la sorgente pubblicata su Confluence) seed:8c8de3bad39b99b7 -->
A volunteer reaches the system either through the public contact form, followed by an invitation sent by an administrator, or directly through registration. Registration offers two paths that converge on the same user model: an email link carrying a one-time code, or Google sign-in; only the email path requires setting a password afterwards. New accounts are created inactive with the volunteer role. Before sensitive operations the volunteer must accept the privacy and operational consents, and an administrator then activates the account. The security guards (reCAPTCHA, rate limit, audit log) apply to the public steps. Day-to-day volunteer work (profile, printers, request workspace, personal to-do list, CSV import of contacts by administrators) is covered by the volunteer-management use cases linked from this page.
<!-- codeforge:body:end -->
